name: REBORNFENIX Founding Warrior #FW06
description: REBORNFENIX Founding Warrior — one of only 22. Imperial Purple. Fully personalised. In ancient Rome, wearing purple without being Emperor was punishable by death. The 22 Founding Warriors carry this colour — not because they claimed it, but because they built the fire that made it possible. This NFT bears the patron's chosen name and zodiac sign, and a sword engraved with a unique combination of Norse runes.
